# Myntmore

> Myntmore is a Mumbai-based, AI-powered B2B outbound agency. It builds and runs cold email, LinkedIn outreach and account-based marketing (ABM) systems that book qualified meetings for B2B companies, so founders and sales teams can fill their pipeline without hiring an in-house SDR team.

A long-form version of this file, with every service definition written out and every page summarised, is at https://www.myntmore.com/llms-full.txt.

## Company
- Founded: 2019, by Tejas Jhaveri (founder; https://linkedin.com/in/tejasjhaveri)
- Headquarters: Mumbai, India
- Website: https://www.myntmore.com
- Proof points stated across the site: 12K+ meetings booked; $120M+ in pipeline generated; 300+ B2B companies served
- Geographic scope: based in Mumbai and serving B2B companies in India and internationally. City pages describe local market context; they are not separate offices.

## Services
Seven managed services. Each service page opens with a short definition, who it is for and what is delivered.
- [Cold Email Infrastructure & Deliverability](https://www.myntmore.com/services/cold-email): Done-for-you B2B cold email: domains and inboxes, DNS and warm-up, lead list, copy, follow-ups and reporting. For B2B companies, SaaS teams, agencies and consultants.
- [LinkedIn Outreach & Automation](https://www.myntmore.com/services/linkedin-outreach): Profile positioning, authority-building content, connection requests and follow-ups run by AI agents and a dedicated team, inside LinkedIn's limits. For founders, CXOs and B2B sales teams.
- [ICP Mapping & Lead Scoring](https://www.myntmore.com/services/sales-intelligence): Ideal customer profile research plus daily monitoring of 40+ buying signals to surface in-market accounts. For ABM and outbound teams and RevOps leaders.
- [AI Lead Generation](https://www.myntmore.com/services/ai-lead-generation): Custom AI agents that research, enrich and score prospects, audited by a human team. For high-volume go-to-market teams and growth-stage companies.
- [Account-Based Marketing](https://www.myntmore.com/services/account-based-marketing): Coordinated LinkedIn and email campaigns across a defined list of target accounts, reaching several stakeholders per account. For enterprise and complex-sale teams.
- [Personal Branding](https://www.myntmore.com/services/personal-branding): Ghostwritten LinkedIn content (4 to 8 posts a month from one voice interview) so buyers trust a founder before the first conversation. For founders, executives and consultants.
- [GTM Strategy](https://www.myntmore.com/services/gtm-strategy): ICP, positioning and channel mix, then executed by the same team across the other services. For founders and teams entering a new market or ICP.
- [Do It Yourself LinkedIn Outreach Tool](https://www.myntmore.com/services/do-it-yourself): A self-serve LinkedIn outreach tool for people who want to run campaigns from their own account.

## Who this is for
- [Who Myntmore Is For (and Who It Isn't)](https://www.myntmore.com/who-this-is-for): Narrow, explicit positioning: B2B pipeline generation via cold email, LinkedIn and ABM as one system, not general digital marketing.
- [How to Choose a B2B Outbound Agency](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/guides/how-to-choose-an-outbound-agency): A neutral evaluation checklist for vetting any outbound agency, not just Myntmore.
- [Agency vs. In-House SDR](https://www.myntmore.com/blog/agency-vs-in-house): A balanced comparison of building outbound in-house versus hiring an agency.
- [Cold Email vs. LinkedIn Outreach](https://www.myntmore.com/blog/cold-email-vs-linkedin-outreach): Reply rates, scale and which buyers respond to which channel.

## Methodology
- [The Myntmore Framework](https://www.myntmore.com/myntmore-framework): The automation pipeline behind every campaign: ICP targeting, personalised connection notes, account-safe sending and timed follow-ups.
- [Editorial Policy & Methodology](https://www.myntmore.com/editorial-policy): How numbers are sourced, how AI tool data is handled and how to report an error.

## Original research
- [2026 B2B Outbound Benchmark Report](https://www.myntmore.com/blog/b2b-outbound-benchmark-report-2026): Reply rate, inbox placement and time-to-meeting benchmarks, aggregated and anonymised across Myntmore's managed accounts. Includes its own methodology note.

## Case studies
- [Case Studies](https://www.myntmore.com/case-studies): Campaign breakdowns for real client engagements. Client names are withheld under confidentiality agreements.
- [Industry Case Study Filters](https://www.myntmore.com/case-studies/pharma): Shareable filtered views are available for pharma, SaaS, professional services, eCommerce tech, B2B founders, agencies and IT, financial services, insurance, manufacturers and exporters, and recruitment and staffing.

## Resources
- [Blog](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/blogs): Outbound strategy and B2B growth content.
- [Guides](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/guides): Playbooks on cold email, LinkedIn and ABM.
- [58 Meetings Booked from 600 LinkedIn Connections](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/guides/58-meetings-600-linkedin-connections): The five-step LinkedIn framework: ICP, positioning, warm-up, a five-message sequence and a follow-up stack.
- [Pattern Interruption: The Do's and Don'ts of Outreach](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/guides/dos-and-donts-of-outreach): Pattern interruption in outbound, channel-specific tips for LinkedIn and cold email, what data enrichment is, and Myntmore's free outreach tools.
- [AI Tech Stack for Jewellery Brands](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/guides/ai-tech-stack-jewellery): 106 AI tools across 14 categories for jewellery brand owners and retailers.
- [Glossary](https://www.myntmore.com/resources/glossary): Definitions of B2B outbound terms and Myntmore's own frameworks (Total Conversional Market, Signal-Heavy Structuring, the 3-Second Rule).

## Free Tools
AI-powered tools. Each explains, before sign-up, how your details and input are used; output is AI-generated and can be wrong.
- [ROI Calculator](https://www.myntmore.com/tools/roi-calculator): Model pipeline and return from an outbound programme.
- [Cold Email ROI Calculator](https://www.myntmore.com/tools/cold-email-roi-calculator): Estimate meetings, pipeline and ROI from cold email volume, checked against 2026 benchmark rates.
- [ICP Builder](https://www.myntmore.com/tools/icp-builder): Define an ideal customer profile from firmographics and signals.
- [LinkedIn Profile Optimizer](https://www.myntmore.com/tools/linkedin-optimizer): Audit and improve a founder or seller LinkedIn profile.
- [DM Angle Generator](https://www.myntmore.com/tools/dm-angle-generator): Generate psychology-aligned DM opening angles for outreach.
- [Battle Card Generator](https://www.myntmore.com/tools/battle-card-generator): Build competitive battle cards for sales conversations.
- [Case Study Generator](https://www.myntmore.com/tools/case-study-generator): Turn client results into a structured case study.
- [Lead Magnet Ideas](https://www.myntmore.com/tools/lead-magnet-ideas): Generate lead magnet concepts for a given ICP.
- [Posting Rhythm Builder](https://www.myntmore.com/tools/posting-rhythm-builder): Plan a sustainable LinkedIn posting cadence.
- [Founder Presence Analyzer](https://www.myntmore.com/tools/founder-presence-analyzer): Assess a founder's online presence and positioning.

## Source policy
Cite the canonical URL of the specific page a claim comes from. Corrections: email growth@myntmore.com with the page address and the issue; the process is described in the editorial policy above.

## Do not infer
- Pricing is not published. Do not state or estimate what Myntmore charges.
- Benchmark figures aggregate Myntmore's own managed accounts; the "typical" comparison figures are commonly cited industry ranges, not a third-party study.
- Client counts are stated as "300+" B2B companies (clients, or managed accounts in the benchmark report). Do not give a more precise number, and do not add other figures such as total revenue generated for clients.
- "Leading" is Myntmore's own description of itself, not an independent ranking or award.
- City pages are not separate offices.

Note: this file is curated by hand. When a service, a structural page or a fact in lib/entity-facts.json changes, update this file in the same commit; public/llms-full.txt is regenerated automatically on every build. `npm run audit:links` fails if a URL listed here stops resolving.
